paite: Huchi in Kumpipa Solomon tuh Israel tengteng kumpipa ahong hita hi.
heading: Solomon Miliante
english: King Solomon was king over all Israel.

paite: Hiaite amiliante ahi uh: Zadok tapa Azariah siampu ahi.
english: These were the princes whom he had: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;

paite: Shisha tapa Elihoreph leh Ahiah laigelhmi ahi uh. Ahilud tapa Jehoshaphat tanchin gelhmi ahi.
english: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;

paite: Jehoiada tapa Benaiah sepaih heutu ahi a; Zadok leh Abiathar siampu ahi uh.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the army; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

paite: Nathan tapa Azariah heutute tung a mi ahi a; Nathan tapa Zabud siampu leh kumpipa lawm ahi khawm hi.
english: Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers; Zabud the son of Nathan was chief minister, the king’s friend;

paite: Ahishar insung lam heutu ahi a; Abda tapa Adoniram phutluih nasemte heutu ahi.
english: Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to forced labor.

paite: Solomon in Israel tengteng tung ah heutu sawm-le-nih anei hi. Huaite'n kumpipa a ding leh a-inkote a ding in nek-le-tak angaihtuah zel uhi. Mi khat in kum khat in kha khat zel nek ding tak ding ape zel hi.
english: Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household. Each man had to make provision for a month in the year.

paite: Hiaite amin uh ahi: Ephraim tanggam ah Ben-hur.
english: These are their names: Ben Hur, in the hill country of Ephraim;

paite: Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-shemesh leh Elon-beth-hanan ah dil Ben-deker ahi.
english: Ben Deker, in Makaz, in Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan;

paite: Arubboth ah Ben-hesed ahi a, ama'n Sokoh leh Hepher gam teng leng atangkhawm hi.
english: Ben Hesed, in Arubboth (Socoh and all the land of Hepher belonged to him);

paite: Dor gam tengteng ah Ben- abinadab ahi a, ama'n Solomon tanu Taphath zi in anei hi.
english: Ben Abinadab, in all the height of Dor (he had Taphath, Solomon’s daughter, as wife);

paite: Tanak khua leh Meggiddo khote, Jezreel kho nuai, Zarethan khochin a om Beth-shean bial teng ah, Beth-shean apan Abel-meholah, Jokmeam gam bul tan in Ahilud tapa Baana ahi.
english: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;

paite: Ramoth-gilead ah Ben-geber ahi a, ama'n Manasseh tapa Jair khote, Gilead gam a omte atangkhawm hi. Bashan gam a Argob bial, kho thupi taktak sawmguk, kulh leh akalhna daltawn neite leng atangkhawm hi.
english: Ben Geber, in Ramoth Gilead (the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead, belonged to him; and the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars, belonged to him);

paite: Mahanaim ah Iddo tapa Ahinadab ahi.
english: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;

paite: Naphtali ah Ahimaaz ahi a, ama'n leng Solomon tanu Basemath zi in anei hi.
english: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon as wife);

paite: Asher leh Bealoth khua ah Hushai tapa Baana ahi a;
english: Baana the son of Hushai, in Asher and Bealoth;

paite: Issakar ah Paruah tapa Jehoshaphat;
english: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;

paite: Benjamin ah Elah tapa Shimei;
english: Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;

paite: Amorte kumpipa Sihon leh Bashan kumpipa Og gam, Gilead gam ah Uri tapa Geber ahi a, Amah huai gam heutu omsun ahi.
english: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer who was in the land.

paite: Judahte leh Israelte tuipi piau a piaunel zah mahmah in atam ua, ane un adawn ua, nuamtak in a-om zel uhi.
heading: Solomon Vaihawm Lohching
english: Judah and Israel were numerous as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and making merry.

paite: Solomon in lui a pan Philistiate gam leh Aigupta gamgi pha in gam teng ah vai ahawm hi. Thilpiakte ahon tawi zel ua, Solomon damsung teng a-nna asem uhi.
english: Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the River to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt. They brought tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life.

paite: Solomon ni khat an nekkhiak, tangbuang nel mahmah pota sawmthum leh tangbuang pota sawmguk;
english: Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty cors of fine flour, sixty measures of meal,

paite: bawngtal thautak sawm, gam a bawngtal sawmnih leh belam zakhat ahi uh. Hiaite lou leng sakhite, sangaite, sakhital, ak vak thaute leng ahi lai uhi.
english: ten head of fat cattle, twenty head of cattle out of the pastures, and one hundred sheep, in addition to deer, gazelles, roebucks, and fattened fowl.

paite: Lui gal khen lam gam teng, Tiphsah a pan Gaza tan, lui gal khen lam a kumpipate tung ah alal hi. Akimvel a mi teng toh kilem in a-om hi.
english: For he had dominion over all on this side of the River, from Tiphsah even to Gaza, over all the kings on this side of the River; and he had peace on all sides around him.

paite: Solomon damsung in Judahte leh Israelte Dan a pan Beer-sheba tan in michih amau grep leh theipi chinna nuai ah bittak in ateng chiat uhi.
english: Judah and Israel lived safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.

paite: Solomon in kangtalai kai sakol singli leh sakol tungtuangmi singkhat-le-sangnih anei hi.
english: Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

paite: Hiai heutute'n amau tankha kha in Solomon leh kumpipa Solomon dohkan hong um teng nek ding apia ua, piak kim louh anei ngei kei uh.
english: Those officers provided food for King Solomon, and for all who came to King Solomon’s table, every man in his month. They let nothing be lacking.

paite: Michih in ahih dia seh bang dungzui in a-omna ding mun ah sakolte leh gan taihat mahmahte a ding in barli buh leh buhpawlte ahon pua uhi.
english: They also brought barley and straw for the horses and swift steeds to the place where the officers were, each man according to his duty.

paite: Pathian in Solomon pilna leh theihsiamna thupi mahmah leh lungsim letna tuipi piau a piaunel bang mai apia hi.
english: God gave Solomon abundant wisdom, understanding, and breadth of mind like the sand that is on the seashore.

paite: Solomon pilna in suahlam ta tengteng pilna leh Aigupta mite pilna tengteng akhup vek hi.
english: Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt.

paite: Mi tengteng sang in apilzaw a, Mahol tapate, Ezrah mi Ethan, Heman, Kalkol leh Darda sang in leng. Huchi in akim a nam tengteng lak ah amin athangkheta hi.
english: For he was wiser than all men—wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol; and his fame was in all the nations all around.

paite: Paunak sangthum agen a, alate sangkhat leh nga ahi uh.
english: He spoke three thousand proverbs, and his songs numbered one thousand five.

paite: Sing tanchin, Lebanon tang a Sidar sing a pan kulhbaang a hong selkhia hissop tan in agen hi. Gamsate tanchin, vasate tanchin, bokvak a paite tanchin leh ngasate tanchin leng agen hi.
english: He spoke of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even to the hyssop that grows out of the wall; he also spoke of animals, of birds, of creeping things, and of fish.

paite: Huchi in Solomon pilna ngaikhe ding in nam tengteng a pan apilna zasate leh lei a kumpipa teng ahong pai uhi.
english: People of all nations came to hear the wisdom of Solomon, sent by all kings of the earth who had heard of his wisdom.
